action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 search over all legal White moves to find the best score and identify commit candidates.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search; required to cover all roots at depth 4 before any single-candidate verification. Black's last move h5h4 attacks the g3 bishop, so the search must evaluate bishop retreats (g3f4, g3e5, g3h4) alongside king/rook activations. Starting fresh after opponent's actual reply h5h4.
